It's gonna give you the best price and you're gonna click swap.

Here is how to buy any meme coin, this simple tutorial will show you how. The first thing you need is metamask. Once you have metamask installed you are going to send ETH into your metamask wallet. You are then going to head to UNISWAP, launch app. Now you're going to get to dex-tools and find the meme coin you want to go into. In this case I want to buy some BAM, so i searched that, and here it is. This will also show you the current chart. Hopefully we can get in before this absolutely moons. Now you're gonna click right here, where it says token and copy address. Then open your metamask and click import tokens at the bottom. Click custom token, and paste the address in there. Now once you have ETH in your wallet and your loaded up with that, you're gonna click this right here and select the token you want to swap your ETH from and then you're gonna click max or put in the amount you want. It's gonna give you the best price and you're gonna click swap.

Here is how to buy any meme coin, this simple tutorial will show you how. The first thing you need is metamask. Once you have metamask installed you are going to send ETH into your metamask wallet. You are then going to head to UNISWAP, launch app. Now you're going to get to dex-tools and find the meme coin you want to go into. In this case I want to buy some BAM, so i searched that, and here it is. This will also show you the current chart. Hopefully we can get in before this absolutely moons. Now you're gonna click right here, where it says token and copy address. Then open your metamask and click import tokens at the bottom. Click custom token, and paste the address in there. Now once you have ETH in your wallet and your loaded up with that, you're gonna click this right here and select the token you want to swap your ETH from and then you're gonna click max or put in the amount you want. It's gonna give you the best price and you're gonna click swap.
